details.biography: Kathy has worked as a stunt professional since 1994, She earned her DGA Directors card in 2008 creating and directing car chases and helicopter to helicopter work over the high mountains of the Wasatch Front. Her expertise is designing, creating and directing vehicle action, helicopter action, all winter sports and specific sport scenes from fencing, snowboarding, skiing and soccer. She was the first female to be trained as a car control specialist at Team O'Neil Rally and Car Control Center. She has raced the notorious Baja 1000 in a Pro-Truck. She raced Rally America series Placing 2nd in Class Nationally. And as a super dirt late model driver, she was the first woman in history to race in The Hell Tour; 29 races in 31 days, covering 8 states. Actors she has doubled for include Meryl Streep, Kate Hudson, Meg Ryan, Hillary Swank, Anne Heche, Jessica Lange, Julie Bowen, Ellen DeGeneres.
details.name: Kathy Jarvis
